title: Mogitate SegaSaturn Vol. 4
native_title: モギタテセガサターン Ｖｏｌ．４ １９９８．８
overview: The fourth issue of Mogitate Sega Saturn, the members-only information disc sent to Sega Partners, Sega's Saturn fan club. Its video features include footage from the Dreamcast unveiling event and from the presentation of D2.
